name: Garage Management - Operational
description: Template; replace entity names and account identifiers before import.

widgets.title: Requests per minute
widgets.query: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'garage-management-api'

widgets.title: Latency P95
widgets.query: SELECT percentile(duration, 95) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'garage-management-api'

widgets.title: HTTP 5xx
widgets.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'garage-management-api'

widgets.title: Service order endpoint traffic
widgets.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'garage-management-api' AND request.uri LIKE '%service-order%'
